content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-prod-canary-1 p95 latency > 1200ms across ~30% of hosts — alert id ALERT-2002345678

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T10:21Z staged rollout job started for release r2026-03-15-batching-kernel-v2 (canary=10%)

alex: saw the page, looking. is this the new batching kernel rollout?

maria: yep, r2026-03-15-batching-kernel-v2. Canary started ~5m ago. Metrics show queue_depth spiking and a lot of kernel_fallback events.

sanjay: logs from canary nodes: `kernel_select: fallback_to_generic=true` and repeated `eviction: KVCache miss pressure`.

lee: observed a throughput drop ~40% for canary slice, tail latency jumps to 3-4s on some reqs. Non-canary is nominal.

alex: rolling back the rollout would be safest but we'd like to try kill-switch first to avoid churn if it's config. Which flag?

maria: feature flag `serve.new_scheduler` is the rollout knob. We can flip to off for canary to force old scheduling path.

emily: customer-impact: CS telemetry shows increased error_rate for tokenization/timeouts for two tenants: acme-payments (high QPS) and chattyapp (many short chats). CS already getting inbound tickets.

cs-bot: Notifying affected customers: Acme Payments, ChattyApp have open support tickets flagged as P2.

alex: I'm going to flip the flag for the canary target group only. Will update here when done.

maria: +1. If that doesn't clear queue, we revert the canary image.

alex: Flipping `serve.new_scheduler=false` for canary slice now (command run):
```
redwoodctl featureflag set serve.new_scheduler=false --scope=canary-slice-7
```

deploy-bot: feature flag change applied to canary-slice-7 (propagation ~15s)

lee: metrics: queue_depth trending down on most hosts, p95 back to ~220ms on the ones that flipped. A couple still high; investigating affinity.

sanjay: nodes with persistent high latency show `kernel_fallback` count still climbing. Those hosts got a partial image update that included a micro-optimizer; suspect binary mismatch with kernel runtime.

alex: ok, plan B: isolate canary-slice-7 from routing for another 5m and start rollback on the subset with the micro-optimizer patch. We'll cordon and revert image for nodes where fallback persists.

maria: issuing routing cut: `routingctl disable-slice canary-slice-7` to drain.

deploy-bot: routing change applied. New incoming traffic avoids canary-slice-7.

emily: CS: telling Acme and ChattyApp we've mitigated and are rolling back the canary subset; they asked for ETA ~30-45m.

alex: starting revert job for affected canary hosts (revert to r2026-03-14-batching-kernel-v1). Command:
```
redwoodctl deploy revert --hosts=@canary-patched --image=r2026-03-14-batching-kernel-v1 --force
```

sanjay: revert in progress on 6 hosts, 2 failed to revert due to disk-space transient error — kicking off cleanup agent.

lee: after first 4 reverts p95 back to baseline across the cluster. The two failed nodes still show fallback but are isolated by routing cut.

alex: cleaning up failed revert nodes now. If cleanup not successful in 10m, I'll reboot and manually reimage.

maria: incident summary so far for postmortem: staged rollout introduced micro-optimizer binary that interacts badly with kernel selection heuristics causing fallback, queue growth, and eviction. Feature flag flip mitigated quickly for impacted slice; routing cut + targeted revert eliminated most customer impact.

emily: customers notified and support updates queued. No broad production outage, but degraded latency and some 5xx/timeouts for heavy QPS tenants ~10-15 minutes.

cs-bot: Notified account execs for Acme Payments and ChattyApp. CS will follow up with timeline and RCA once postmortem is ready.

alex: handoff to night oncall @sanjay — I'll stay available for 30m to complete remaining reimages. Add to incident channel and create PagerDuty follow-up if any regressions.

sanjay: taking handoff. I'll monitor kernel_fallback and queue_depth dashboards and double-check autoscaler behavior for evicted hosts. If we see >5% of hosts still evicting, escalate to ENG-SRE.

maria: agreed. Action items: 1) rollback micro-optimizer from canary images, 2) add a binary compatibility check to pre-rollout pipeline, 3) add an alert for spike in `kernel_fallback` events, 4) postmortem within 48h.

alex: creating the incident ticket and linking runbook: INCIDENT-2002345678. Runbook steps followed: feature-flag, routing-cut, targeted-revert.

incident-bot: Incident created INCIDENT-2002345678 — severity: S2 — assignee: sanjay — postmortem due by 2026-03-17.

emily: thanks team. I'll draft customer communication and attach logs + timeline.

sanjay: monitoring. ping here for anything urgent.

alex: closing thread for now but will append any late churn. Good work on fast kill-switch flip. :thumbsup:
